title: Bisphosphonates for the prevention of osteoporotic fractures
text: Bisphosphonates inhibit osteoclast-mediated bone resorption by binding to hydroxyapatite in bone and inducing osteoclast apoptosis. Long-term use has been shown to reduce the incidence of vertebral and hip fractures in postmenopausal women with osteoporosis.
